# Check earlier frames for the bottle contact
# Let's check obs_0013, obs_0014, obs_0015
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

for f_id in [13, 14, 15]:
    img = np.array(Image.open(f'/work/observations/obs_{f_id:04d}.png'))
    # search for blue pixels
    blue_pixels = []
    for r in range(img.shape[0]):
        for c in range(img.shape[1]):
            if img[r, c, 2] > 100 and img[r, c, 0] < 50:
                blue_pixels.append((r, c))
    if blue_pixels:
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in blue_pixels)
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in blue_pixels)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in blue_pixels)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in blue_pixels)
        print(f'obs_{f_id:04d}: r in [{min_r}, {max_r}], c in [{min_c}, {max_c}], count={len(blue_pixels)}')
"
